'''Johanna N. Y. Franklin''' is an American [[mathematician]] and professor of mathematics working at [[Hofstra University]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hofstra.edu/faculty-staff/faculty-profile.html?id=4715 |title=Johanna N. Y. Franklin |access-date=August 5, 2025}}</ref> She is known for her work on [[algorithmic randomness]].

== Biography ==

Franklin completed her BS and MS at [[Carnegie Mellon University]], and her PhD, on ''Aspects of Schnorr Randomness'' under the supervision of [[Theodore Slaman]] at [[University of California, Berkeley]], in 2007.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=116264 |title=Mathematics Genealogy Project: Johanna N. Y. Franklin |publisher=North Dakota State University |access-date=August 5, 2025}}</ref>

She has held postdoctoral research positions at the [[National University of Singapore]], [[Fields Institute]], [[University of Waterloo]], [[Dartmouth College]], and [[University of Connecticut]], and has worked at [[Hofstra University]] since 2014, where she was promoted to professor in 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://johannafranklin.net/franklin_cv.pdf|title=Curriculum vitae|access-date=2025-08-16}}</ref>

Franklin is an editor of the ''Archive for Mathematical Logic''<ref>{{cite web |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/153/editorial-board |title=Archive for Mathematical Logic: Editorial Board |publisher=Springer |access-date=August 5, 2025}}</ref> and a reviews editor for the ''Bulletin of Symbolic Logic''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/bulletin-of-symbolic-logic/information/about-this-journal/editorial-board |title=Bulletin of Symbolic Logic: Editorial Board |publisher=Cambridge University Press |access-date=August 5, 2025}}</ref>

== Awards and recognition ==
In 2024, Franklin received the [[Association for Women in Mathematics]] Service Award, which recognizes "individuals who have demonstrated exceptional service to the AWM by promoting and supporting women in mathematics."<ref>{{cite web |last1=Greenberg |first1=Ginny |url=https://news.hofstra.edu/2024/03/08/franklin-honored-by-the-assoc-for-women-in-mathematics/ |title=Franklin Honored by the Assoc. for Women in Mathematics |date=March 8, 2024 |publisher=Hofstra News |access-date=August 5, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://awm-math.org/awards/awm-service-award/ |title=AWM Service Awards |publisher=Association for Women in Mathematics |access-date=August 5, 2025}}</ref>

== Notable Publications ==

=== Books ===

* 2026. ''Effective Metric Structure Theory'' (co-authored with [[Isaac Goldbring]], and [[Timothy H. McNicholl]]). Springer Cham, Springer Monographs in Mathematics.

=== Co-edited Volumes ===
* 2020. ''Algorithmic Randomness: Progress and Prospects'' (co-edited with [[Christopher P. Porter]]). Cambridge University Press, Lecture Notes in Logic, vol. 50.
* 2022. ''Revolutions and Revelations in Computability'' (co-edited with Ulrich Berger, [[Florin Manea]], and [[Arno Pauly]]). Springer, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 13359.
